claims.explanation: Mitoxantrone kills via topoisomerase II poisoning, so sensitivity is driven by TOP2A/TOP2B expression and apoptosis competence. Resistance is primarily mediated by ABCG2 (and ABCA3) efflux, which lowers intracellular drug. Observed sensitivity patterns also associate with KRAS wild-type and mutations in EGFR, ATM, PIK3CA, FBXW7, or ARID1A.
